about_the_game:
The VR version of your final wizard exam has arrived! Will you pass the test?

Immerse yourself in Mystic Academy VR, an exhilarating escape room that will challenge your magical prowess. Solve puzzles, decipher mystical artifacts, learn spells, find hidden objects, and explore your wizardry school — now in virtual reality! Overcome daunting trials to prove your wizardry skills and succeed in the exam!

This version has been redesigned for Virtual Reality: existing puzzles have been reimagined, new ones added, and the entire experience adapted to fully embrace physical interaction. Wield your wand, interact with your surroundings, and master a unique spellbook system to learn and cast spells as you uncover the secrets of the academy!

Features

  • All puzzles require logic (and a touch of your wizard skills!).

  • Explore diverse rooms in your wizardry school.

  • Uncover more about your magical abilities, learn new spells, and put them to the ultimate test — in full VR!

  • Use your wand and spellbook to interact with a fully immersive magical world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX950
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus PC
